review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMCID:PMC5131774, Structural Biology and Evolution of the TGF-beta Family
primary_title: Binding affinity of transforming growth factor-beta for its type II receptor is determined by the C-terminal region of the molecule
decision_basis: The reviews identify TGFBR2 as the initial type-II receptor for TGF-beta ligands and cite the primary isoform/mutant analysis measuring high-affinity TGF-beta1 binding to TGFBR2.
limitations_preserved: Binary binding only; preserve mature TGF-beta1 form, type-II receptor specificity, and C-terminal ligand determinants; no complete type-I/type-II complex or SCI inference.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC6920667, Structural biology of the TGFbeta family; PMCID:PMC10267471, TGFbeta signaling pathways in human health and disease
primary_title: Binding affinity of transforming growth factor-beta for its type II receptor is determined by the C-terminal region of the molecule
decision_basis: The reviews identify TGFBR2 as the initial type-II receptor for all TGF-beta isoforms and cite the primary isoform/mutant analysis showing TGF-beta2 binding to TGFBR2 with lower affinity than TGF-beta1.
limitations_preserved: Binary binding only; preserve lower-affinity TGFB2-TGFBR2 interaction and betaglycan/TGFBR3-assisted productive signaling context; no claim of equivalent affinity or direct complete-complex assembly.
